formula.canonicalInci: AQUA (WATER, EAU), SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE, COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE, SODIUM CHLORIDE, DIMETHICONE, HYDROLYZED KERATIN, COMBRETUM FARINOSUM FLOWER NECTAR, PARFUM (FRAGRANCE), SODIUM BENZOATE, PEG-7 GLYCERYL COCOATE, CITRIC ACID, AMODIMETHICONE, GUAR HYDROXYPROPYLTRIMONIUM CHLORIDE, GLYCOL DISTEARATE, LAURETH-4, PEG-120 METHYL GLUCOSE DIOLEATE, GLYCERIN, HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL, LAURETH-23, TRIDECETH-10, SODIUM HYDROXIDE, CITRUS AURANTIUM PEEL OIL, LIMONENE, PHENOXYETHANOL, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, SODIUM SALICYLATE, BENZYL ALCOHOL, POTASSIUM SORBATE

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: SLES at position 2 and CAPB at position 3 provide effective ordinary cleansing, while early dimethicone, keratin and later amodimethicone/cationic guar keep the complete architecture from reading as strong reset.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: dimethicone at position 5, keratin, amodimethicone, cationic guar and lipid/waxy refatting clues create a substantial rinse-off repair-care system.

weightPotential.rationale: High: early dimethicone, amodimethicone, cationic guar, keratin and waxy/refatting clues create a persistent multi-route deposition system despite ordinary SLES/CAPB reset.

focusPrimary.rationale: Repair: the revealed product positioning targets dry, damaged hair and liquid keratin, and the formula has a compatible silicone, keratin and cationic-polymer repair-care system.

focusSecondary.rationale: Shine secondary: the source explicitly promises glossy hair, and the silicone/smoothing system provides an independent route beyond the keratin-led repair positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are standard wet-hair distribution, rinse-out and regular use; no daily/frequent, alternating, reset or treatment trigger is present.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: the product targets dry/damaged hair fiber repair, softness and shine, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete canonical formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

thicknesses.rationale: Early dimethicone plus keratin, amodimethicone, cationic guar and high weight potential make loss of lift too plausible for fine hair.
The repair-care stack can help damaged normal hair, but high weight potential makes it situational rather than an ideal diameter-level default.
Coarse hair is the best default fit for this high-conditioning/high-weight repair and shine profile.

primary.rationale: The product is positioned for dry/damaged hair repair and shine rather than a named scalp concern; ordinary balanced scalp route is the only supported production target.
